preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 3 * 10^5.
The number of queries is between 1 and 5 * 10^5.
Each vertex has a distinct integer p_i from 1 to n initially written on it.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for all i
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= v <= n for queries of type 1
preconditions.description: The vertex v for queries of type 1 is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= i <= m for queries of type 2
preconditions.description: The edge i for queries of type 2 is between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: For each query of type 1, output the value of p_u written on the vertex u with the largest p_u among all vertices reachable from v.
postconditions.description: If all vertices reachable from v have p_i set to 0, any vertex can be chosen, and the output should be 0.

postconditions.expression: For each query of type 2, remove the specified edge from the graph.
postconditions.description: The edge is guaranteed to exist and not be deleted yet.
